    stats_df = ecm_results$stats, sig_threshold = threshold,
    site_vars_lookup = site_vars_common
  )
  if (!is.null(fig)) {
    ecm_genus_figures[[genus]] <- fig
  }
}

# ── EcM master figure (all significant panels, p < 0.1) ──────────────────────
build_study_column <- function(all_results_list, study_name, stats_df, site_vars_list) {
  study_key <- ifelse(study_name == "Hunter", "hunter", "snowy")
  plots <- list()
  for (genus in names(all_results_list)) {
    genus_study_plots <- all_results_list[[genus]][[study_key]]
    if (is.null(genus_study_plots) || length(genus_study_plots) == 0) next
    for (var_name in names(genus_study_plots)) {
      var_label <- site_vars_list[[var_name]]$label
      sig_row <- stats_df %>% filter(Genus == genus, Dataset == study_name, Site_Variable == var_label)
      if (nrow(sig_row) > 0 && !is.na(sig_row$p_value) && sig_row$p_value < threshold) {
        plots <- c(plots, list(genus_study_plots[[var_name]]))
      }
    }
  }
  plots
}

ecm_hunter_col <- build_study_column(ecm_results$plots, "Hunter", ecm_results$stats, site_vars_common)
ecm_snowy_col <- build_study_column(ecm_results$plots, "Snowy", ecm_results$stats, site_vars_common)
max_plots <- max(length(ecm_hunter_col), length(ecm_snowy_col))

title_hunter <- ggplot() +
  annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "Hunter Mining", size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
  theme_void()
title_snowy <- ggplot() +
  annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "Snowy Hydro", size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
  theme_void()

ecm_master_list <- list(title_hunter, title_snowy)
for (i in seq_len(max_plots)) {
  p_h <- if (i <= length(ecm_hunter_col)) {
    ecm_hunter_col[[i]]
  } else {
    ggplot() +
      theme_void()
  }
  p_s <- if (i <= length(ecm_snowy_col)) {
    ecm_snowy_col[[i]]
  } else {
    ggplot() +
      theme_void()
  }
  ecm_master_list <- c(ecm_master_list, list(p_h, p_s))
}

if (length(ecm_master_list) > 2) {
  tags <- c(paste0(letters, ")"), paste0("a", letters, ")"))
  plot_idx <- 1
  for (i in 3:length(ecm_master_list)) {
    row_i <- floor((i - 3) / 2) + 1
    col_i <- ((i - 3) %% 2) + 1
    is_real_hunter <- col_i == 1 && row_i <= length(ecm_hunter_col)
    is_real_snowy <- col_i == 2 && row_i <= length(ecm_snowy_col)
    if (is_real_hunter || is_real_snowy) {
      ecm_master_list[[i]] <- ecm_master_list[[i]] + labs(tag = tags[plot_idx])
      plot_idx <- plot_idx + 1
    }
  }
  ecm_master <- wrap_plots(ecm_master_list,
    ncol = 2,
    heights = c(0.12, rep(1, max_plots))
  ) &
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold"), plot.tag.margin = margin(0, 8, 0, 0))
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "Figure_EcM_Master_SiteRecovery.png"),
    plot = ecm_master, width = 14, height = min(4 * max_plots + 2, 300),
    dpi = 300, bg = "white", limitsize = FALSE
  )
}

# ── Statistics table ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
all_stats <- rbind(ecm_results$stats) %>% #
  arrange(Guild, Dataset, Genus, Site_Variable)

if (nrow(all_stats) > 0) {
  all_stats$p_formatted <- format_p_val(all_stats$p_value)
  all_stats$df <- ifelse(is.na(all_stats$df1) | is.na(all_stats$df2), NA,
    paste0(all_stats$df1, ", ", all_stats$df2)
  )
  display_cols <- c(
    "Genus", "Guild", "Site_Variable", "Dataset", "n",
    "R_squared", "F_statistic", "df", "p_formatted"
  )
  ft <- flextable(all_stats %>% select(-p_value, -df1, -df2), col_keys = display_cols) %>%
    set_header_labels(
      Genus = "Genus", Guild = "Guild", Site_Variable = "Site Variable",
      Dataset = "Dataset", n = "n (Rehab)", R_squared = "R\u00B2",
      F_statistic = "F", df = "df", p_formatted = "p-value"
    ) %>%
    align(align = "center", part = "all") %>%
    align(j = c(1, 2, 3, 4), align = "left", part = "body") %>%
    bold(part = "header") %>%
    italic(j = "Genus", part = "body") %>%
    autofit() %>%
    bold(i = ~ Significance %in% c("+", "*", "**", "***"), j = "p_formatted")
  tables_dir <- file.path(proj_root, "output/tables")
  dir.create(tables_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  save_as_docx(ft, path = file.path(tables_dir, "Table_Genera_SiteRecovery_Statistics.docx"))
  sig_results <- all_stats %>% filter(Significance %in% c("*", "**", "***"))
}

ecm_master
# Display stats
ft
